description: Text appears in the bottom center with a black background, saying 'META JUST LAUNCHED'. Then it transitions to 'PAID SUBSCRIPTION' in the top left, and 'PAID PLANS FOR' in the bottom center. After that, 'PAID SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR' appears at the top, and social media logos (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp) pop up next to it, with corresponding app names appearing below them in the bottom center.
description_orig: Bold text 'PAID SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR' with Instagram logo and 'INSTAGRAM,' appears on screen, overlaid on the speaker.
video_title: Why Meta wants you to pay now!

description: Text appears in a black box at the bottom center of the screen, fading in and out. The text changes from 'PLANS?' to 'WHEN THE REAL' then to 'QUESTION IS HOW' then to 'DOES THE' then to 'MAKE' and finally 'MORE MONEY'. The video then transitions to 'WHEN IT ALREADY' then 'HAS 3' then 'BILLION' and finally 'THE ANSWER'.

description: Two bullet points appear one after the other on the screen, starting with 'ARPU' and then 'Willingness To Pay'.

description: The video transitions from a talking head to a split screen with a text box at the top and Mark Zuckerberg speaking at the bottom.
